'''Troy''' is a male NPC who appears at the bar in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]]. He can be seen talking to [[Andrius]] during the daytime.

==Quests and Events==
''(To Be Added)
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Andrius:''' You should know that people from Rinascita place a high value on family honor and kinship.
:'''Andrius:''' Without an influential family behind you, it's nearly impossible to rise in Ragunna.
:'''Andrius:''' But the Montellis are different. We believe opportunities multiply when they're shared. Money means nothing unless it's in circulation.
:{{DIcon}} Are you a Montelli?
:'''Andrius:''' Of course! That's why we get to sit here.
:'''Troy:''' I want to be rich too! I want people to be in awe whenever they speak my name! I'll make the most of this opportunity!
:'''Andrius:''' Then go for it! Do whatever it takes to earn your status and honor.
:'''Andrius:''' These things won't just fall into your lap—they're up to you to pursue.
:'''Andrius:''' If you share my belief, I promise that serving the Montelli family will not leave you wanting.
:'''Andrius:''' Shall we toast?
:'''Troy:''' C-can I?
:'''Andrius:''' Of course! I might be your employer, I prefer to see us as partners.
:'''Troy:''' W-well, cheers, then!
{{Dialogue End}}
